known_differences.description: Event API supports terminal as bool or positive int; fail count semantics match upstream.
Tolerance warning surfaces for tiny rtol values; strict mode mirrors warning behavior while hardened mode clamps rtol below MIN_RTOL.

threats.description: Tiny or sub-epsilon rtol values cause step-size underflow and excessive step rejections in adaptive IVP solvers.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:337 (validate_tol): enforces MIN_RTOL floor with RtolClamped warning in Strict mode and audited BoundedRecovery clamp in Hardened mode.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamp rtol to MIN_RTOL and emit ToleranceWarning::RtolClamped matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Clamp rtol to MIN_RTOL and record BoundedRecovery in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Non-finite trial step evaluations (NaN/Inf RHS output) during RK stepping can corrupt state trajectories.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/api.rs:1189 (solve_ivp): checks trial step RHS finiteness and rejects or shrinks step rather than propagating NaN.
threats.strict_mode_response: Shrink step or terminate with step-size failure matching SciPy RK solver.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite RHS output fail-closed and record audit event.

threats.description: Boundary-value collocation residuals on stiff or ill-conditioned two-point problems can stall Newton iterations.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/bvp.rs:205 (solve_bvp): monitors collocation mesh residual and enforces max_nodes budget.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SolveBvpResult with status code matching SciPy when mesh budget is exceeded.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce mesh node cap and emit structured failure status.

threats.description: NaN, Inf, or negative values in scalar or vector atol/rtol inputs corrupt error norm scaling.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:337 (validate_tol): rejects negative or non-finite rtol/atol values with IntegrateValidationError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed with NonFiniteInput or NegativeAtol and record FailClosed audit entry.

threats.description: Non-positive or out-of-bounds first_step parameter violates integration interval invariants.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:243 (validate_first_step): validates first_step > 0 and within |t_bound - t0|.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(FirstStepMustBePositive) or Err(FirstStepOutOfBounds) matching SciPy.

threats.description: Vector atol shape mismatch against state dimension n causes out-of-bounds or mis-scaled error norms.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:337 (validate_tol): verifies vector atol length equals state dimension n.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Empty initial state y0 or mismatched initial RHS output length causes degenerate loop or panic.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/api.rs:1199 (solve_ivp_with_audit): validates y0 non-empty and f(t0, y0) dimension before stepping.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err on empty y0 or wrong RHS output length.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Return Err and emit AuditAction::FailClosed into ledger.

threats.description: Non-positive max_step allows invalid step size bounds in adaptive integrators.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:297 (validate_max_step): rejects max_step <= 0 or NaN.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed prior to solver allocation.

threats.description: Audit fingerprint collisions when t_eval or non-finite y0 values are omitted from the input hash.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/api.rs:1199 (solve_ivp_with_audit): hashes method, t_span, y0, t_eval, rtol, atol, max_step, and mode via BLAKE3.
threats.strict_mode_response: Emit distinct BLAKE3 input_fingerprint for distinct t_eval vectors.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Emit distinct BLAKE3 input_fingerprint including non-finite y0 payloads.

threats.description: Adaptive quadrature (quad) subdivision limit exhaustion on oscillatory or singular integrands.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/quad.rs:256 (quad): enforces subdivision limit and returns error estimate with convergence status.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match QUADPACK subdivision limit and error estimate reporting.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Terminate at configured limit and report residual error bound.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject NaN/Inf tolerances and step bounds matching SciPy.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject input and emit deterministic NonFiniteInput FailClosed audit record.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: Explicit compatibility override with audit record in policy ledger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return argument error matching upstream solver naming constraints.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: No runtime override; requires explicit code-level allowlist update.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Use SciPy-compatible defaults when event metadata is omitted.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Validate event direction and terminal count before integration.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Terminate when step size falls below floating-point spacing.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Fail closed when step or subdivision budget is exhausted.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: Controlled budget configuration via SolveIvpOptions / QuadOptions.
